sentences.text: The said substance was worth Rs.3,83,960/-.
In his remand report, name of the present applicant has surfaced as a 'supplier' to him.
3. Pertinent to note that said Shaf Shamshul Aalam was arrested and was released on bail on 14/06/2022 by the learned Magistrate, Mazgaon.

Considering the legal position revolving around invocation of Section 328 of IPC and since the legal conundrum is pending before the highest Court of this country, the applicant deserves his protection from arrest by way of following ad-interim order.

: ORDER :
(a) In the event of arrest in connection with C.R.No.658 of 2022 registered with L.T.Marg Police Station, applicant-Mohammed Saeed Khan s/o Nisar Ahmed Khan shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(b) The applicant shall report to the concerned police station on 19th and 20th September, 2022 between 2.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m. and, thereafter, as and when called for.
